payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed information about the current state-of-the-art models for speech recognition on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) dataset, including their architectures and performance metrics.

claims.text: The current best model on WSJ is an HMM-based system that combines convolutional, recurrent, and fully connected layers, achieving the lowest Word Error Rate (WER).
An end-to-end system using lattice-free MMI on augmented data achieves state-of-the-art performance on WSJ, comparable to the best models.
A fully convolutional approach trained end-to-end from raw waveforms matches the current state-of-the-art on WSJ.
